title: Peruvian Pork Roast with Umami Glaze
description: A savory Peruvian-inspired pork roast glazed with a rich umami sauce, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with umami seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the pork to a plate and set aside.
Add the roasted garlic, aji amarillo pepper, and brown sugar to the pot. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the apple cider vinegar and bring to a simmer.
Return the pork to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the roast vegetables to the pot and continue roasting for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the pork is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Let the pork rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
